title: buildHomeMachines
responsibility: Counts active runs by computer and joins current remote-work leases to displayable sessions.

inputs.name: isActiveHomeRun.run
inputs.description: One Tracker run with its lifecycle state and optional end timestamp.

inputs.name: buildHomeMachines.sources
inputs.description: The validated Tracker items, runs and machine records for a single read.

inputs.name: buildHomeMachines.runs
inputs.description: Tracker runs grouped by item and already deduplicated by origin and run ID.

inputs.name: buildHomeMachines.listed
inputs.description: Item IDs eligible to show titles in the Home snapshot.

outputs.name: isActiveHomeRun
outputs.description: True for a running, verifying or observed run with no end timestamp.

outputs.name: buildHomeMachines
outputs.description: One computer summary for every reported computer, with active counts and allowed session details where current.
